criterion.name: Outline of project
criterion.requirement: A very well defined project proposal which demonstrates a clear and detailed understanding of what the project entails.

criterion.name: Project plan
criterion.requirement: A comprehensive breakdown of all the elements within the project, which demonstrates a sound methodology for completing the project.

criterion.name: Time planning
criterion.requirement: A comprehensive and detailed time plan of when each element within the project can be completed.

criterion.name: Literature review
criterion.requirement: A comprehensive initial literature review relevant to defining the project scope, which demonstrates a good understanding of the background to the project.
